ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Race Tracker inoshandisa nzvimbo yauri kana kutevera mujaho kwakabatidzwa, kunyange skrini yakakiyiwa, kuti inyore nzira yako uye igovane nzvimbo yauri izvozvi nevarongi vemujaho uye, kunze kwekunge wazvidzima, nevaoni pamepu yemujaho.
